introProse: A predatory mountain beast prowls forth from the dense thicket, eyes locked upon your panoply as its claws score the limestone!

victoryOutcome.text: Your blade drives the beast back into the rocky fissures. The grove returns to tranquil peace.

addJournalChronicle.title: Guardian of the Cleft
addJournalChronicle.text: Overcame a predatory beast stalking the perimeter of the sanctuary.
